''Steelhowl'' is a [[Bloodline|bloodline]] game done in a typical one-year fashion. A new 500-year-old world was created using DF v0.40.24 for this fortress. Using vanilla Dwarf Fortress should work, but [http://dffd.bay12games.com/file.php?id=7622 PeridexisErrant's Lazy Newb Pack 0.40.24 r12] is highly suggested. <s>[[User:Cobalte|Cobalte]]</s> Armok created the world. [[User:Cobalte|Cobalte]] is the first overseer of Steelhowl.
